_readme: Single source of truth for every business-specific value in the generated JSON-LD. Fill in verified values only. Any field left as an empty string or empty array is OMITTED from the generated markup (never emitted as a placeholder), and is listed in output/VALIDATION-REPORT.md so you can see what is still missing.
_areaServedHelp: Replace business.areaServed with the real coverage. For a service-area business, list the actual cities/regions, e.g. { "type": "City", "name": "Sydney", "sameAs": "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q3130" }. Supported 'type' values: Country, State, City, AdministrativeArea, Place. Each service in services.json may override this with its own areaServed.
_openingHoursHelp: Add entries shaped like { "dayOfWeek": ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"], "opens": "07:00", "closes": "17:00" }. Leave the array empty rather than guessing; hours in markup must match the website and Google Business Profile.
_aggregateRatingHelp: Only fill this in if genuine, first-party review data is visible on the page itself. Google's review snippet policy prohibits marking up ratings that a visitor cannot see on that page, and self-serving LocalBusiness ratings are ignored. Leave empty otherwise.
